Manish Sharma Appointed President of Escorts Kubota's Agri Business

Manish Sharma, former Chairman and CEO of Panasonic India, has been appointed as the President of Agri Business at Escorts Kubota. The appointment was announced following a regulatory filing by the farm and construction equipment manufacturer. Sharma is a veteran executive in the consumer durables and manufacturing sectors.
